title: Dog Grooming
excerpt: Our grooming salon, The Stylish Dog, in Ash. Full pamper sessions, puppy grooms, hand stripping and a quick wash and go after muddy walks.
intro: The Stylish Dog is Take The Lead's grooming salon at 55 Guildford Road, Ash. We use gentle daily shampoos with a fresh fragrance and finish every groom with a coat-conditioning spray, and we stock shampoos and conditioners for different coat types and skin conditions.
highlights: Full breed styling, clips and scissor trims
Gentle puppy grooms to build confidence
Shampoos and conditioners for different coats and skin conditions
pricingNote: Prices depend on your dog's size, coat condition and the style you want. We'll give you an estimate when you book and confirm it on the day. Cancellations with less than 24 hours' notice may be charged.

prices.label: Full pamper session
prices.detail: Bath, brush out and hand dry. Clip or scissor trim. Nails clipped. Ears plucked and cleaned.

prices.label: Mini groom
prices.detail: Bath, brush out and hand dry. Nails clipped. Feet trimmed. Ears plucked and cleaned.

prices.label: Puppy groom
prices.detail: Bath, brush out and hand dry. Nails clipped. Ears cleaned.

prices.label: Hand stripping
prices.detail: Bath, brush out and hand dry. Hand stripping of the dead coat (for non-shedding wire-coated breeds). Nails clipped. Ears plucked and cleaned.

prices.label: Wash and go
prices.detail: Bathed and blast dried. Perfect after wet, muddy walks. Subject to availability.
